Man Stabs Police in Delhi's Jama Masjid Station, Arrested After Firing

In Delhi's Jama Masjid police station, a 25-year-old man identified as Nabeel attacked police personnel with a knife during questioning, injuring five officers. Three of the injured officers are reported to be in serious condition. The assailant fled the scene but was apprehended by police in the Chitli Kabar area, where officers fired eight shots, hitting the accused. The incident occurred at the Jama Masjid police station.
